themes.definition: Occurrences arising from the US-Israel war on Iran begun 2026-02-28 and the Hormuz closure that followed: tanker rerouting, war-risk insurance, munition stockpile replenishment, Iran-attributed action abroad. Belongs here when Iran or the strait is the actor or the object, not merely a place mentioned in passing.

themes.label: Biological hazard, animal disease and the food chain
themes.definition: Occurrences where a pathogen moving through animals is the actor: highly pathogenic avian influenza and its wild-bird and mammal spillovers, African swine fever, foot-and-mouth, screwworm, and the farm, veterinary, disposal and food-supply consequences that follow from them, including culling, indemnity, export bans, vaccination policy and the egg and protein prices they move. Distinct from THM-08, which is geophysical and climate hazard (earthquake, flood, fire, heat) and takes no view on pathogens. Belongs here when a disease in animals is the cause of the occurrence, not merely a backdrop; a human influenza vaccine story belongs here only when the animal outbreak is what moved it.

changelog.change: CREATE from Ron's 2026-09-10 occurrence, the H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b panzootic. The first theme in this store about biology: the other thirteen are geopolitics, policy, capital cycles and geophysical hazard, and nothing in them claims an animal pathogen. Precedence limitation, stated rather than worked around: rule assignment takes the first theme in list order whose rule fires, so an avian-influenza occurrence that also names China or a tariff is claimed by that earlier theme instead. Left as it is because changing global precedence is not this run's mission; a hand assignment overrides it where it matters.

themes.label: Nuclear power buildout
themes.definition: The nuclear-power supply chain reasserting itself under AI and grid demand: reactor OEMs and SMR developers, fuel and uranium enrichment and mining, plant restarts and life extensions, utility offtake deals, and the state and multilateral financing behind new build. A single dedicated wire (World Nuclear News) carries most of this volume. Excludes nuclear-weapons and proliferation stories, screened by the not clause below; claimed after THM-01 and THM-02, which take the case when Iran or Russia/Ukraine is the named actor even at a nuclear-armed or nuclear-plant site.

changelog.change: CREATE. 39 occurrences carry World Nuclear News, a single-subject wire that has run almost daily since 2026-09-01, as their source and sat entirely unassigned: SMR orders (Rolls-Royce, TerraPower, Blykalla, Kairos), fuel and enrichment deals (Orano/KHNP, Centrus/Radiant), restarts (Duane Arnold, Palisades) and utility offtake (Google/Finland). Bare 'nuclear' already claims all 39 because the wire's own name carries the word, which is why the term list is short. One more (a Niger uranium-permit story) surfaces on 'uranium'; a North Korea weapons-arsenal story also carries 'nuclear' but is excluded by not: arsenal, since a warhead build-out is a different subject than power capacity. Real, sustained, single-source-evidenced volume with no existing theme built to hold it

themes.label: Israel-Gaza war and its regional fallout
themes.definition: The Israel-Hamas war on Gaza, the occupied West Bank, and the diplomatic and economic fallout it forces elsewhere: strikes and casualties, settler and settlement expansion, sanctions on settlements or officials, blockade and reconstruction, arms deals, and the Lebanon/Hezbollah front it has opened. A distinct, sustained conflict from THM-01's Iran/Hormuz war and THM-02's Russia/Ukraine war; claimed after both, so an item naming Iran or Hormuz stays with THM-01 even when Israel is also named.

changelog.change: CREATE. 29 occurrences spanning every week the log holds (2026-08-26 to 2026-09-10) sat unassigned under Gaza, West Bank and Israel-adjacent terms: settler violence and home demolitions, the UK's Israeli-settlement sanctions and the diplomatic response to them, the Israel-Greece $3.5bn defence deal, and the Hezbollah/Lebanon front. Out of THM-01's scope by that theme's own definition, which is Iran and Hormuz specifically. A war this large and this sustained with nowhere to log it was the gap, not a manufactured cluster. 'settlement'/'settlements' deliberately left off the term list: bare, it also matches a Meta legal settlement, an SEBI options-settlement story and a patent settlement, none of them this war; 'israelis' is listed separately from 'israeli' because the whole-word matcher does not treat one as a prefix of the other

CREATE ten seed themes over the 339-row occurrence log. Each carries a definition and an explicit match rule, so an assignment is reproducible and the gate can re-run it. Order is narrow to broad: the first theme whose rule matches wins, which is why the two war themes sit above energy infrastructure and the subject themes sit above the two source-shaped buckets at the end.
